nemvoting.counting_whitelist: Only votes from the whitelisted addresses count. Only confirmed votes count.
nemvoting.approximate_note: The importance as of the end of the poll was not available, so today's importance was used.
nemvoting.xem_short_warning: Not enough XEM. You need XEM for the fee.
nemvoting.single_warning: This poll allows one option per account. Voting for another option after this makes your vote invalid.
confirm_dialog_message: Once your password is verified, your vote will be sent.

done_message: Your vote has been sent.
It will show in the results once the network confirms it.
error_insufficient_balance_message: The total fee is more than your XEM balance.
Add some XEM and try again.
error_deadline_message: The transaction deadline could not be set correctly.
Check your device date and time, then try again.
error_wrong_network_message: The selected network differs from the account's network.
error_conflict_message: The network did not accept it.

error_poll_ended_message: You can't vote because the poll has ended.
nemvoting.error_poll_invalid_title: 🔴 You can't vote in this poll
error_poll_invalid_message: The option addresses could not be verified.
nemvoting.error_duplicate_title: 🟡 A poll with this title exists
error_duplicate_message: Your account has already created a poll with the same title.
Change the title and try again.
nemvoting.error_partial: {{sent}} of {{total}} messages were already sent. The poll is not listed until the last one arrives. Please create it again with a different title.
nemvoting.create_intro: A poll is written to the blockchain and also appears in the official NEM Wallet's list. It can't be changed after it is created.
nemvoting.options_hint: {{min}} to {{max}} options. They must all differ.
nemvoting.end_hint: No one can vote after this time.
nemvoting.type_poi_hint: Anyone can vote; votes are weighted by each account's importance.
nemvoting.type_whitelist_hint: Only the listed addresses can vote; one address, one vote.
nemvoting.whitelist_placeholder: One per line (or separated by commas / spaces)
nemvoting.multiple_hint: When off, an account that votes for more than one option has no valid vote.
nemvoting.issue_title_long: The title can be up to {{max}} characters
nemvoting.issue_end_past: Pick a time in the future
nemvoting.issue_too_large: This is too large. Shorten the description, options or whitelist.
nemvoting.cost_hint: A poll is written as several 0-XEM transfers with messages; only their fees are charged.
create_confirm_dialog_message: Once your password is verified, the poll will be created.

create_done_message: It will appear in the list once the network confirms it.

txuri.title: Transaction URI
txuri.hint: The transfer you are typing, as a web+symbol://transaction URI (and QR code). It is not signed - whoever opens it reviews it and signs it themselves.
txuri.qr_too_long: The URI is too long for a QR code. Copy the text instead.
txuri.deadline_note: The deadline is 2 hours from now. The wallet that opens the URI may set its own deadline and fee.
txuri.build_failed: Could not build the URI. Check what you entered.
txuri.load_hint: Paste a web+symbol://transaction?data=... URI (a transfer), a web+symbol://request?... URI or an address to fill in the recipient, mosaic, amount and message.
txuri.unsupported: This URI cannot be loaded. Only transfer transaction URIs are supported.
txuri.multiple_mosaics: Transfers with several mosaics cannot be loaded (the send screen takes one mosaic).
txuri.encrypted_message: Transfers with an encrypted message cannot be loaded.
